name: obsidian-finance
description: 4 finance skills for quarterly U.S. equity research with SEC evidence, Taiwan-listed issuer research with tw-equity-research, quarterly market research, and standalone stock technical analysis with source cutoffs and protected checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: 4 finance skills for U.S. and Taiwan equities, markets and technical analysis
interface.longDescription: Use four finance skills. Use equity-research-us to start or continue quarterly research on U.S.-listed companies in managed version-1 equities folders, preserving reports and edits and acquiring source-linked SEC evidence when required. Use tw-equity-research for quarterly Taiwan Stock Exchange-listed issuer research with dated corporate disclosures. Use industry-research for quarterly Obsidian market studies and their source-linked continuation. Live SEC acquisition uses a genuine contact saved locally after first-use setup. Offline research can reuse existing evidence without a contact. Use technical-analysis for dated technical outlooks from latest or local U.S. stock daily bars. Offline technical analysis uses Python 3.11+ and the standard library. Live price fetching uses isolated optional dependencies. Evidence gaps are reported explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Continue research in my designated managed equities folder at my specified assessment cutoff; discover required work, preserve prior reports and edits, and report evidence gaps and conditional horizon judgments.
